items.html: Thus it is found that it is neither literally Elohim, because it is in Arich Anpin, nor literally mercy (Rahamim), which is the Name YHVH; rather, it is the Name Metzpatz, intermediate between them, for it is neither literally YHVH nor literally Elohim, but intermediate between them, as mentioned, and it is their substitute. And later we shall complete the explanation of this reason in its truth, see there.
